author: Howsie
body:
Come join us on the avicus teamspeak! Here you will be able to talk to staff and other players in a very easy and conventional way. You will also have our very able staff team there to cater to all your needs, for example reporting a player or if you are stuck and need to ask a question. 

IP - ts.avicus.net

Make sure you abide by all server rules located here - http://avicus.net/rules

Instructions for Installation:
1. http://www.teamspeak.com/?page=downloads Click this link
2. Choose your platform (Client - 32bit/64bit depending on your computer's OS) and confirm the download
3. Follow the instructions after installation
4. Go to the Connect area and connect to the ip ts.avicus.net
